description: Create animations.css and responsive.css with all Phase 4 CSS: animations with prefers-reduced-motion, responsive breakpoints, skeleton shimmer loading states, focus-visible ring, and skip-nav styling. Import both new files in main.tsx.
steps: Create frontend/src/styles/animations.css with the following keyframes and classes: (a) @keyframes panel-slide-in using translateX(100%) to translateX(0) over 150ms ease-out, and panel-slide-out reverse. (b) Button hover transitions: .btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .btn-tertiary get transition: background-color 100ms ease. (c) Input focus transition: .input gets transition: border-color 100ms ease, box-shadow 100ms ease, outline 100ms ease. (d) Status chip appear: @keyframes chip-appear from opacity:0 scale(0.9) to opacity:1 scale(1), 150ms ease-out, applied to .status-chip. (e) Tooltip fade-in: .icon-rail__tooltip--visible gets opacity transition 150ms. (f) Card hover lift: a .card class with transition: box-shadow 150ms ease, and .card:hover with box-shadow: var(--shadow-md). (g) Skeleton shimmer: @keyframes shimmer (background-position sweep from -200% to 200%), class .skeleton-shimmer with subtle gradient background and animation 1.5s infinite. (h) Panel slide class: .panel-slide-in applies the panel-slide-in animation. (i) All animations wrapped in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) that disables animations (animation: none, transition: none for relevant selectors).

Create frontend/src/styles/responsive.css with: (a) @media (max-width: 1280px): .panel-left { display: none; } .panel-right { width: 280px; }. (b) @media (max-width: 1024px): .icon-rail { width: 44px; padding: 0; } .icon-rail__item { height: 44px; } .panel-left, .panel-right become overlay (position: fixed, top: 0, right/left: 0, height: 100vh, z-index: 1000, width: 280px). .canvas-area { width: 100%; } .top-bar__brand { max-width: 120px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .status-bar__item:not([data-testid='status-bar-errors']) { display: none; } (c) Touch target minimum: all buttons/interactive elements get min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px. (d) CSS custom property override: --icon-rail-width: 44px at 1024px breakpoint on .app-shell.
Add global focus-visible styling in animations.css: *:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } *:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none; }

Add .skip-nav styles in animations.css: visually hidden by default (position: absolute, width: 1px, height: 1px, overflow: hidden, clip: rect(0,0,0,0)), and .skip-nav:focus makes it visible (position: fixed, top: 8px, left: 8px, z-index: 9999, padding, background, etc.)
In frontend/src/main.tsx, add import '@/styles/animations.css'; and import '@/styles/responsive.css'; after the existing CSS imports (after components.css import).
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/styles/animations.css exists with all specified keyframes, transitions, and prefers-reduced-motion media query
frontend/src/styles/responsive.css exists with @media queries for 1280px and 1024px breakpoints
Skeleton shimmer animation uses CSS only (no JS library), with a gradient sweep keyframe
All animation durations are max 200ms (except shimmer which is a loading indicator at 1.5s)
Focus-visible ring is 2px accent with 2px offset, only on keyboard navigation
Skip-nav link styling is present (visually hidden, visible on focus)
main.tsx imports both new CSS files
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && npx vite build
unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && npx vitest run
findings: Build and all 1094 tests pass. Animations.css and responsive.css created and imported. All acceptance criteria met.
